targetText: The crisis arises because no standard exists whereby the real demand for a commodity may at any time be measured and ascertained.
summary: Analyzing periodic capitalist crises of overproduction, Bebel explains how the anarchy of capitalist commodity production and the restricted purchasing power of the working class cause recurring economic depressions alongside massive waste in middleman commerce.
